name: bidinn-crm
description: Bidinn Sales CRM — run frontend and backend together

scripts.setup: yarn --cwd backend install && yarn --cwd frontend install
scripts.start: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta --prefix "[{name}]" --prefix-length 10 --kill-others-on-fail "yarn --cwd backend watch" "FORCE_COLOR=1 yarn --cwd frontend start | cat"
